crossRefs.note: A foolish son is the calamity of his father. A wife’s quarrels are a continual dripping.
It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman.
It is better to dwell in a desert land, than with a contentious and fretful woman.
A continual dropping on a rainy day and a contentious wife are alike:
He who pampers his servant from youth will have him become a son in the end.

translations.web: for an unloved woman when she is married, and a servant who is heir to her mistress.
translations.bsb: an unloved woman who marries, and a maidservant who supplants her mistress.
translations.kjv: For an odious woman when she is married; and an handmaid that is heir to her mistress.
translations.asv: For an odious woman when she is married; And a handmaid that is heir to her mistress.
